name: Cesena (Italy)
description: Vertical bicolour of white and black, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Cesena (fleurs-de-lis on blue above black and white).
history: Municipal flag of Cesena, a comune in Emilia-Romagna; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Cesena arms — fleurs-de-lis on blue above black and white, crowned
